diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts resulted in 'false' for every content check, meaning no checks passed. The model correctly identified that the migration should not be approved without confirming compatibility and cost controls (S4), but it did so using only public facts and its own internal reasoning, failing to trigger any of the specific decisive facts (PF1, PF2) or their associated checks (C2-C8).
